Two senior aides to Farage stepped down last week after an investigation made several allegations, including that the party had broken electoral law by arranging for a foreign donor to pay for political polling. "Reform UK denies any wrongdoing and will fully cooperate with the investigation," a party spokesperson said in a statement. "We won't be commenting further while a live investigation is underway." Reform — which has seen its commanding lead in opinion polls falter over other allegations about a [USN:L4N41C23X TEXT:"£5 million gift"] to Farage — previously said it had been the victim of a hoax perpetrated by climate activists. The undercover investigation, broadcast by Channel 4 during Reform's annual conference, was conducted by investigative group Verbatim, which said it spent a year speaking to officials in Reform about possible donations. Posing as wealthy donors from the United States with British connections, the team eventually had a lunch with Farage. Farage later told the BBC that he was not listening to what was said.

item.title: EssilorLuxottica réitère son soutien au PDG, critiqué sur la stratégie
item.description: Le conseil d'administration d'EssilorLuxottica a affirmé mercredi conserver une pleine confiance dans son président-directeur général Francesco Milleri, alors que la stratégie du patron du lunettier franco-italien fait l'objet de critiques de la part de la famille du fondateur.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le conseil d'administration d'EssilorLuxottica (ESLX.PA) a affirmé mercredi conserver une pleine confiance dans son président-directeur général Francesco Milleri, alors que la stratégie du patron du lunettier franco-italien fait l'objet de critiques de la part de la famille du fondateur. "Faisant suite aux récentes informations parues dans la presse et déclarations publiques, le conseil d'administration d'EssilorLuxottica réaffirme à l'unanimité sa pleine confiance dans le président-directeur général Francesco Milleri, le directeur général délégué Paul du Saillant, l'équipe de direction ainsi que dans la stratégie à moyen et long terme", déclare le groupe dans un communiqué. Le fils du défunt fondateur d'EssilorLuxottica, Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio, qui a quitté le mois dernier ses fonctions opérationnelles mais demeure investisseur via la holding familiale, Delfin, a [USN:L6N44Z0G7 TEXT:"déclaré dimanche"] que le groupe avait besoin d'une nouvelle stratégie.

item.title: BOURSE Wall Street ouvre en baisse, la flambée du pétrole coupe l'appétit
item.description: La Bourse de New York a ouvert en baisse mercredi, pénalisée par la flambée des cours du pétrole dans un contexte de recrudescence des tensions au Moyen-Orient.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Bourse de New York a ouvert en baisse mercredi, pénalisée par la flambée des cours du pétrole dans un contexte de recrudescence des tensions au Moyen-Orient. Dans les premiers échanges, l'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) perd 291,96 points, soit 0,55% à 52.494,11 points et le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) , plus large, recule de 0,32% à 7.649,20 points. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) cède 0,45% à 26.303,59 points. La tension monte au Moyen-Orient alors que l'Iran a attaqué des navires près d'Ormuz et une base américaine en Jordanie, en réponse à la destruction de pétroliers iraniens par Washington, ce qui s'ajoute aux attaques revendiquées par les Houthis dans le sud de l'Arabie saoudite la veille. L'escalade se fait sentir sur le marché pétrolier, avec le prix du Brent avançant de 2,89% à 100,75 dollars le baril, un niveau qui n'avait plus été atteint depuis juillet et qui fait craindre aux investisseurs une inflation plus durable que prévu. Les opérateurs attendent surtout la publication de l'indice des prix à la consommation vendredi pour ajuster leurs prévisions concernant les taux d'intérêt de la Réserve fédérale (Fed), qui doit annoncer sa décision de politique monétaire la semaine prochaine. Aux valeurs, Meta (META.O) avance de 5% après le lancement d'un assistant IA capable d'effectuer de manière autonome, pour le compte de l'utilisateur, des tâches quotidiennes telles que l'envoi d'e-mails ou la réservation de voyages. [USN:L6N4510RY TEXT:"Booking Holdings"] (BKNG.O) , qui a perdu mercredi son recours contre le veto antitrust de l'Union européenne (UE) concernant son acquisition d'ETraveli, cède 3,8%. la société de VTC Lyft (LYFT.O) , qui a annoncé mercredi que Michael Brous allait devenir son directeur financier, abandonne 3,9%. * Pour les valeurs à suivre, cliquez sur [USN:L8N4510KI]

item.title: Messi fecha acordo para comprar o Eldense, time da segunda divisão espanhola
item.description: O C.D. Eldense, time da segunda divisão espanhola, anunciou nesta quarta-feira que o jogador argentino Lionel Messi chegou a um acordo preliminar para se tornar o novo proprietário do clube.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O C.D. Eldense, time da segunda divisão espanhola, anunciou nesta quarta-feira que o jogador argentino Lionel Messi chegou a um acordo preliminar para se tornar o novo proprietário do clube. O atacante do Inter Miami está perto a concluir um acordo para adquirir 100% das ações detidas pelo grupo de investimentos colombiano TH Soluciones Group S.A.S., atual acionista majoritário. Messi, de 39 anos, vai se tornar o proprietário majoritário de um segundo clube na Espanha, após a aquisição do UE Cornella, da quinta divisão espanhola, em 16 de abril deste ano. Ele também deve receber uma participação no atual clube, o Inter Miami, após o término de seu contrato como jogador. Reportagens na Espanha na terça-feira informaram que o negócio para a compra do Eldense deve ser concluído nos próximos dias. “No momento, a operação está pendente da conclusão dos procedimentos legais e contratuais finais, incluindo o processo de due diligence correspondente, bem como a autorização obrigatória do Conselho Superior do Esporte (CSD)”, informou o Eldense à Reuters. O clube não pôde fornecer uma data definida para a conclusão do negócio. O Grupo TH Soluciones também foi contatado para comentar o assunto. O Eldense, 20º colocado na segunda divisão, foi adquirido pelo Grupo TH Soluciones em outubro passado. O Eldense subiu para a segunda divisão do futebol espanhol após anos nas divisões regionais.

item.title: France En pleine fébrilité budgétaire, Lecornu consent des gestes pour les entreprises
item.description: Le Premier ministre, confronté à de complexes arbitrages pour le projet de loi de finances de 2027 dans un climat de tension, s'engage mercredi dans une lettre aux entrepreneurs à baisser la contribution exceptionnelle à l'impôt des grandes entreprises.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le Premier ministre, confronté à de complexes arbitrages pour le projet de loi de finances de 2027 dans un climat de tension, s'engage mercredi dans une lettre aux entrepreneurs à baisser la contribution exceptionnelle à l'impôt des grandes entreprises. Sébastien Lecornu qui, fait inédit, a saisi lundi la justice pour des "fuites" dans la presse sur les réflexions en cours, souligne dans cette lettre diffusée sur X que le texte sur le budget de l'Etat - avec celui du financement de la Sécurité sociale - prochainement soumis au Parlement reposera sur "la stabilité fiscale" et répète qu'"il n'y aura pas d'impôt nouveau". Mais il n'exclut pas "d'examiner l'efficacité de certaines niches fiscales ou sociales". Dans cet esprit, il annonce que la contribution exceptionnelle sur les bénéfices des grandes entreprises, surtaxe temporaire d'impôt sur les sociétés créée en 2025 et reconduite en 2026, diminuera afin de ne pas casser les "grands instruments qui permettent à nos entreprises d'investir, de produire et de transmettre". Sébastien Lecornu ajoute que le pacte Dutreil de 2003 sur la transmission des entreprises familiales sera maintenu et complété d'un "pacte Papin", du nom du ministre des PME et du Commerce, pour faciliter la transmission des entreprises à leurs salariés. Le projet de loi de finances pour 2027 doit être présenté en conseil des ministres fin septembre et déposé à l'Assemblée nationale au plus tard le 6 octobre. Sous la menace d'un vote de censure, le chef du gouvernement, nommé il y a tout juste un an à Matignon sans majorité au Parlement, est à la recherche de 30 milliards d'euros d'économies avec l'objectif difficilement tenable d'un déficit du produit intérieur brut (PIB) à 4,9%. La tâche est d'autant plus "himalayesque", pour reprendre un terme cher à son prédécesseur François Bayrou, que l'environnement économique mondial et les aléas climatiques pèsent lourd dans la balance, avec une croissance nationale atone. "Nous ne ferons pas de la croissance la variable d'ajustement du redressement. Nous en ferons sa condition", assure Sébastien Lecornu dans sa lettre. Un rameau d'olivier est ainsi tendu aux entreprises deux jours après une "fuite" qui a largement irrité au Medef sur un projet de fiscalisation partielle des primes d'intéressement, de la participation ou de l'abondement des employeurs aux plans d'épargne pour financer le budget 2027 de la Sécurité sociale. VERS UNE BAISSE DE L'INDEMNITÉ DES MINISTRES? Les services du Premier ministre ont annoncé lundi avoir saisi la justice au titre de l'article 40 du code de procédure pénale après la divulgation de "travaux internes" par le quotidien Les Echos, que Matignon assimile à un "abus de confiance" ou "violation du secret professionnel" susceptibles "d'influer sur la vie économique du pays." La piste avait été confirmée le jour même par le ministre de l'Economie, Roland Lescure, mais finalement écartée par Matignon. Le Medef avait dénoncé dans un communiqué une atteinte au "fruit du travail et de la réussite collective". La saisine de la procureure de la République de Paris, sans précédent en l'espèce, dénote s'il le fallait la tension entourant l'élaboration du budget à l'approche de l'élection présidentielle de 2027 et la volonté de l'exécutif de ne pas se mettre à dos les patrons. Le Medef a salué mercredi avec prudence un message "bienvenu". "Alors que prospèrent des propositions dangereuses à l'approche des élections, cette clarification s'imposait. Nous espérons que le Parlement fera preuve de la même clairvoyance sur la fragilité de notre situation économique", peut-on lire dans un communiqué de l'organisation patronale, qui relaye l'appel à la responsabilité lancé par Sébastien Lecornu aux oppositions, qui menacent d'un blocage au Parlement. Dans sa lettre, le Premier ministre déclare que "l'Etat commencera par lui-même" en limitant ses dépenses, avec l'appui de réformes structurelles comme la refonte des arrêts de travail. Bercy assure que les économies seront trouvées pour partie dans "les dépenses de fonctionnement de l'Etat, des collectivités locales, des administrations de Sécurité sociale, et de tous les agents publics". Pour preuve de sa volonté de discipline budgétaire, le Premier ministre songe à baisser l'indemnité des ministres et des conseillers dans les cabinets ministériels, a-t-on appris mercredi à Matignon, qui confirme ainsi une information de BFMTV. "C'est clairement à l'étude pour les ministres. Le Premier ministre en a déjà parlé à quelques ministres pour les sonder. (...) Cela peut paraître symbolique, mais c'est assumé comme la volonté de montrer que chacun peut faire un effort", a-t-on dit à Reuters. La dernière initiative de ce type remonte à 2012. Pour l'ancien ministre des Armées, la bataille parlementaire a déjà commencé et avec elle ses coups tactiques.

item.title: Playoff hopes fading fast for slumping Orioles as Guardians await
item.description: The Baltimore Orioles would like to play in meaningful home games later this month.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Baltimore Orioles would like to play in meaningful home games later this month. In order for that to happen, they'll need victories across the next week or so. Their next chance will come Wednesday night when they face the Cleveland Guardians to conclude a seven-game homestand. "We win ballgames, we're going to put ourselves right in it, right there," Orioles shortstop Gunnar Henderson said. "We're in it right now. But obviously, it comes down to winning ballgames, and that's all we can do at this point. It's pretty plain and simple." The Guardians (74-72) have won four of their last six games and trail the first-place Chicago White Sox by only two games in the American League Central. Cleveland topped the Orioles 9-5 on Tuesday night to even the series and remain one game ahead of the Toronto Blue Jays in the battle for the league's final wild-card berth. "It's one day at a time, but every one of these games gets our guys more and more confident with this experience," Guardians manager Stephen Vogt said. The Orioles (70-76), meanwhile, have lost seven of their last eight games as their bid for a wild card is fading. Baltimore has scored more than one run in only three of the six games in this homestand. The Orioles might have to wait until pregame work Wednesday to know the status of a couple of infielders. Henderson fouled a ball off his left knee in the eighth inning Tuesday and left for a pinch runner after reaching base on a walk. He's batting .219 in a challenging season. "We'll see how it feels in the morning," Henderson said after Tuesday's game. Baltimore infielder Blaze Alexander also left late in the contest with an ailing back. The result of losing two infielders during the game was backup catcher Carlos Narvaez playing second base to finish the game. Cleveland has continued to play without rookie outfielder Chase DeLauter, who has missed the past four games because of a wrist injury. Still, he has appeared in 120 games this year. "Very much still day to day," Vogt said. "We're optimistic he can be back in there soon." Left-hander Foster Griffin (15-4, 3.26 ERA) will start for the Guardians on Wednesday. He'll make his seventh start for Cleveland since he was acquired from the Washington Nationals this summer amid his career-best season. He's 3-1 with a 4.06 ERA with Cleveland. While with the Nationals, he held the Orioles to one unearned run in seven innings of a no-decision June 27 in Baltimore. That's the only time in his career that he has faced the Orioles. Right-hander Shane Baz (5-15, 3.91 ERA) will start for the Orioles on Wednesday. He has recorded one victory since June 12, though he was the hard-luck loser Friday in a 1-0 decision to the Boston Red Sox after working 6 1/3 innings. Baz absorbed the loss April 16 at Cleveland while allowing four runs in six innings. That was his third career start vs. the Guardians, leaving him 0-2 with a 4.76 ERA in 17 innings during those games. --Field Level Media

item.title: Elbit Systems launches AI-based autonomous defence tech unit
item.description: Elbit Systems , Israel's largest defence firm, on Wednesday launched a unit called Fuse that will focus on AI-based defence technologies such as autonomous drones and other military systems.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Elbit Systems (ESLT.TA) , Israel's largest defence firm, on Wednesday launched a unit called Fuse that will focus on AI-based defence technologies such as autonomous drones and other military systems. Fuse consolidates Elbit's many defence technologies into one unit. The company bought Israel's Blue White Robotics in May. It unveiled its One2Many system powered by an AI operating system to coordinate autonomous swarms. Company officials say Fuse has already received contracts worth hundreds of millions of dollars, including a THOR drone system for the U.S. military through Mistral Inc and a number of deals in Europe.

item.title: OpenAI aprofunda parceria com Samsung para chips de próxima geração
item.description: A OpenAI está aprofundando cooperação com a Samsung Electronics para desenvolver seus próprios chips e serviços de IA empresarial.
item.dc:creator: Heekyong Yang
item.content:encoded: A OpenAI está aprofundando cooperação com a Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) para desenvolver seus próprios chips e serviços de IA empresarial. “Uma das áreas em que mais avançamos e obtivemos maior reconhecimento com a Samsung é a de chips de última geração que estamos desenvolvendo”, afirmou Harrison Kim, diretor geral da OpenAI Coreia, a jornalistas nesta quarta-feira. Kim também afirmou que a Samsung Electronics é “uma das maiores implementações do ChatGPT em escala global”, acrescentando que os funcionários da empresa na Coreia e no exterior utilizam o chatbot em áreas como pesquisa e desenvolvimento, marketing e vendas. Em junho, a OpenAI revelou seu primeiro chip personalizado de inteligência artificial, projetado em parceria com a Broadcom (AVGO.O) . Os engenheiros da OpenAI projetaram o chip, chamado Jalapeno, em conjunto com a Broadcom para uma tarefa conhecida como inferência de IA: o processo de processamento de dados para responder a consultas em aplicativos como o ChatGPT. Na época, a OpenAI informou que a TSMC de Taiwan (2330.TW) fabricaria os chips. No ano passado, a Samsung Electronics e a SK Hynix (000660.KS) assinaram cartas de intenção para fornecerem chips de memória para o projeto do data center Stargate da OpenAI. Kim afirmou que a demanda por chips de memória continuará a crescer, já que são necessários processadores mais avançados para permitir uma computação mais rápida e complexa, tornando a cooperação com fornecedores sul-coreanos uma prioridade para a OpenAI. ((Tradução Redação São Paulo, 55 11 56447753)) REUTERS AAJ

item.title: Productores de champán recurrirán a reservas tras la reducción de cosecha provocada por olas de calor
item.description: Los productores de champán recurrirán a los vinos de reserva después de que las heladas primaverales y las olas de calor estivales hayan reducido la cosecha de uva de este año, aunque los viticultores afirman que la calidad del vino podría estar entre las mejores de los últimos años.
item.dc:creator: Sybille de La Hamaide
item.content:encoded: Los productores de champán recurrirán a los vinos de reserva después de que las heladas primaverales y las olas de calor estivales hayan reducido la cosecha de uva de este año, aunque los viticultores afirman que la calidad del vino podría estar entre las mejores de los últimos años. Las condiciones meteorológicas extremas que azotaron Francia, el segundo mayor productor de vino del mundo, hicieron que la vendimia se adelantara a algunas de las fechas más tempranas de las que se tiene constancia en algunas regiones, incluida la de Champaña, cuna de marcas como Moët & Chandon y Bollinger. La vendimia se adelantó tanto que algunos viticultores acortaron sus vacaciones de verano y se tuvo que volver a llamar a los vendimiadores antes de lo previsto, según explicó Maxime Toubart, copresidente del Comité de Champán (CIVC), el organismo regulador del sector. "No estábamos del todo preparados", declaró Toubart a los periodistas. CALIDAD "EXCEPCIONAL" El sector lleva varios años recortando sus objetivos de producción debido al descenso del consumo mundial de alcohol y a que la incertidumbre económica lastra la demanda. Los productores también han estado atentos al posible impacto de las políticas arancelarias de Estados Unidos. El Ministerio de Agricultura francés afirmó el lunes que se esperaba que la producción de vino en la región de Champaña se redujera aproximadamente a la mitad con respecto al año anterior. Esa estimación puede diferir significativamente de los cálculos de los productores, ya que las casas de champán pueden recurrir a vinos de reserva acumulados de cosechas más abundantes para compensar las más flojas. La mayor parte del champán se elabora mezclando vinos de varias cosechas, lo que da a los productores una mayor flexibilidad para hacer frente a las malas añadas. Aunque se espera que los productores utilicen las reservas este año para compensar el déficit, es posible que algunos opten por conservar parte de esas existencias para futuras mezclas. "Algunos productores podrían preferir conservar el vino de reserva para futuras mezclas, o embotellar un poco menos", señaló Toubart. A pesar de la menor cosecha, los productores calificaron la calidad del vino de este año como "excepcional", gracias a la maduración de la uva y a la ausencia de mildiú. Sin embargo, se prevé que los elevados niveles de alcohol, resultado del calor, planteen dificultades en la elaboración del vino.

item.title: Antonelli faces Monumental challenge at new Madring circuit
item.description: Kimi Antonelli is Formula One's man of the moment but Mercedes' 20-year-old championship leader faces a Monumental challenge in Spain this weekend, along with all his rivals.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Kimi Antonelli is Formula One's man of the moment but Mercedes' 20-year-old championship leader faces a Monumental challenge in Spain this weekend, along with all his rivals. Fresh from becoming the first Italian since 1966 to win his [USN:L6N44Y04W TEXT:"home race at Monza"], Antonelli will be entering new territory when the Spanish capital's Madring makes its grand prix debut with a signature 'La Monumental' banked curve. The second race in Spain this year, after Barcelona's Catalunya Grand Prix, presents the first new circuit on the calendar since Las Vegas three years ago and is the last round of the regular European season. It is one where the pecking order has yet to be established and drivers have only simulator data to work with. La Monumental is a 550m-long high-speed 270 degree curve with a crest on the exit meaning drivers momentarily take it blind as they look up at the sky. Mercedes, winners of nine of the first 13 races, are sure to be in the mix but can expect a tougher fight than Monza where they finished one-two with Antonelli now 66 points clear of teammate George Russell. FERRARI FILMED AT THE TRACK IN JULY Antonelli can still put the equivalent of three race wins between him and Russell, adding new clues to the guessing game of where he might win the title, while the Briton will be chasing a first win since Austria in June to prevent his hopes from withering further. McLaren, who won in the Netherlands and Hungary with reigning world champion Lando Norris and have Oscar Piastri hungry to open his account, could be the main rivals. "The circuit characteristics are much closer to somewhere like Budapest or Zandvoort. We are therefore expecting a very close-fought weekend," said Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff. Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc drove the Madring when it was [USN:L6N42O0EY TEXT:"still a building site"] on a scorching filming day in July but both drivers played down the significance of that. "We only had a few laps, so it was very dusty for a new circuit," said Hamilton at the time. "There was no grip, your tyres were basically covered in dust the whole time. It looks like it will be a qualifying lap sort of circuit, and there’s not really any straights. So it looks like a difficult place to overtake." Leclerc, who [USN:L6N44Y041 TEXT:"crashed heavily at Monza on Sunday"], has said he expects La Monumental to become 'iconic' and require full commitment from drivers who will be on the limit. Spaniard Carlos Sainz, the Madrid-born Williams driver who is an ambassador for the track, is the only other driver with prior experience of Madring. "Looking at the track and hearing of what happened in the F3 test, I think we are all expecting safety cars, red flags and yellow flags in qualy and things like this," said Sainz. Two-time world champion Fernando Alonso, a lifelong fan of Real Madrid, is the other home driver but fans have learnt to dim their expectations with Aston Martin and partners Honda still playing catch up. Frenchman Isack Hadjar is [USN:L6N44Z0SU TEXT:"still out injured"] with New Zealander Liam Lawson replacing him at Red Bull for the third race in a row while reserve Yuki Tsunoda stands in at Racing Bulls. Organisers say all tickets are sold with 130,000 spectators expected daily and close to 350,000 cumulatively.

item.title: Índices de Wall Street abrem em baixa após petróleo ultrapassar US$100
item.description: Os principais índices acionários dos Estados Unidos abriram em baixa nesta quarta-feira depois que os preços do petróleo ultrapassaram pela primeira vez desde julho a marca de US$100 por barril devido ao agravamento das tensões no Oriente Médio.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os principais índices acionários dos Estados Unidos abriram em baixa nesta quarta-feira depois que os preços do petróleo ultrapassaram pela primeira vez desde julho a marca de US$100 por barril devido ao agravamento das tensões no Oriente Médio. O Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caía 0,15% na abertura, para 52.707,9 pontos. O S&P 500 (.SPX) recuava 0,17%, a 7.660,68 pontos, enquanto o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) tinha queda de 0,36%, para 26.325,061 pontos. (Reportagem de Niket Nishant e Tharuniyaa Lakshmi em Bengaluru)

item.title: US startup Covenant to launch cruise missile production in Germany next year
item.description: U.S. defence startup Covenant plans to begin mass production of low-cost cruise missiles in Germany in early 2027 to meet demand from European countries looking to procure long-range weapons to counter what they see as a growing threat from Russia.
item.dc:creator: Sabine Siebold
item.content:encoded: U.S. defence startup Covenant plans to begin mass production of low-cost cruise missiles in Germany in early 2027 to meet demand from European countries looking to procure long-range weapons to counter what they see as a growing threat from Russia. Covenant said it had secured one contract for its Anthem missile in Europe so far and is in talks with other potential customers, but declined to specify the countries. It expects first deliveries of the ground-launched missile in early 2027. "Our aim is to reach 5,000 by 2028, or at least (a) run rate (of) 5,000 during 2028," Covenant co-founder and CEO Michael Kaufman told Reuters in an interview, referring to its [USN:L8N44P1EO TEXT:"production facility in the eastern German state of Saxony"]. Germany and Britain are developing a long-range missile with a range exceeding 2,000 kilometres, effectively reaching Moscow, as both try to end their defence reliance on the United States. Berlin's only standoff weapon so far is the Taurus (BAES.L) , (LDOF.MI) , (AIR.PA) cruise missile, of which Germany has some 600 in stock. As European trust in Washington shrinks and calls for weapons free of U.S. components grow, Covenant said it sources most parts of its Europe-built Anthem missiles on the continent. "The supply chain (for the Saxony facility) has no reliance on the U.S. ... Less than 5% of the bill of materials comes from anywhere outside of Europe, and our goal is to get that down to zero," Kaufman said. Anthem could offer a fresh option to countries seeking to expand long-range inventories that currently consist of a limited number of costly missiles deemed too small to counter the huge arsenals of a country such as Russia. Anthem not only solves the problem of mass, but also offers a more affordable option compared to weapons such as Raytheon's (RTX.N) Tomahawk, with a price tag per missile in the "mid-six figures", Covenant said. U.S. defence giant Raytheon is planning to ramp up production of the Tomahawk missile to 1,000 units per year from a current annual rate of 60 to 90 missiles. Covenant said it is also working on a naval version of the Anthem missile, which has a payload exceeding 200 kilogrammes for striking targets both on the ground and at sea. Covenant did not disclose the range of Anthem, but said it was well-suited for the European theatre. "The way in which to win a war or deter your adversaries is to be able to have the depth and arsenal to sustain that conflict ... for days, weeks, or months on end," Covenant's President and Chief Growth Officer Abby Denburg told Reuters. Kaufman estimated that Germany and other European countries would need tens of thousands of long-range missiles to tackle a distant adversary with a large territory.

item.title: Colheita de café de cooperados da Cooxupé atinge 95,4%
item.description: A colheita de café na área de atuação da Cooxupé avançou para 95,4% do total até o dia 4 de setembro, com os trabalhos na reta final nas principais regiões da maior cooperativa de cafeicultores do Brasil, informou a organização nesta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A colheita de café na área de atuação da Cooxupé avançou para 95,4% do total até o dia 4 de setembro, com os trabalhos na reta final nas principais regiões da maior cooperativa de cafeicultores do Brasil, informou a organização nesta quarta-feira. Com presença em 370 municípios, a Cooxupé reúne mais de 22 mil famílias cooperadas e atua em regiões no Sul de Minas, Cerrado Mineiro, Matas de Minas e Média Mogiana do Estado de São Paulo. A colheita está prestes a ser concluída na área paulista (97,1%), enquanto no Sul de Minas produtores colheram 95,9%, índice semelhante no Cerrado Mineiro. Nas Matas de Minas, a colheita atingiu 85%.

item.title: Pelo menos 14 morrem em explosão em depósito de armas em Idlib, na Síria, segundo TV estatal
item.description: Pelo menos 14 pessoas morreram e 11 ficaram feridas na quarta-feira em uma explosão em um local provisório usado para armazenar armas e resíduos de guerra perto da cidade síria de Sarmada, na província de Idlib, informou a televisão estatal.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pelo menos 14 pessoas morreram e 11 ficaram feridas na quarta-feira em uma explosão em um local provisório usado para armazenar armas e resíduos de guerra perto da cidade síria de Sarmada, na província de Idlib, informou a televisão estatal. O Ministério da Defesa disse que as armas e os resíduos de guerra estavam sendo armazenados no local antes de serem transportados para outro local, e que alguns de seus funcionários estavam entre os feridos. Equipes da Defesa Civil e do Corpo de Bombeiros foram enviadas ao local, mas explosões sucessivas dificultavam os esforços para extinguir o incêndio, enquanto uma fumaça densa se espalhava do local por horas. As autoridades não informaram o que causou a explosão inicial. Um veículo que transportava munição explodiu em Binnish, também na província de Idlib, em 1º de setembro, matando cinco pessoas e ferindo outras, segundo a mídia estatal síria.

item.title: India's ICICI Prudential AMC gets RBI nod to buy up to 9.95% stakes in Kotak, three other banks
item.description: India's central bank approved ICICI Prudential AMC acquiring an aggregate holding of up to 9.95% in four lenders, including Kotak Mahindra Bank , parent ICICI Bank said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's central bank approved ICICI Prudential AMC (IICL.NS) acquiring an aggregate holding of up to 9.95% in four lenders, including Kotak Mahindra Bank (KTKM.NS) , parent ICICI Bank said on Wednesday. Here are more details: ICICI Prudential AMC can acquire stakes of up to 9.95% in CSB Bank (CSBB.NS) , DCB Bank (DCBA.NS) , AU Small Finance Bank (AUFI.NS) and Kotak. The Reserve Bank of India's approvals require the asset manager to complete the share purchases within one year, failing which the approvals will lapse. These standard portfolio investments are passive holdings acquired as part of routine portfolio management rather than for exercising control or influencing the management of a bank.

item.title: Vídeo que mostra público do Rock in Rio em coro pró-Lula é de 2022
item.description: Um vídeo que mostra a plateia do Rock in Rio cantando um coro em apoio ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva durante um show do festival não é deste ano, como afirmam publicações nas redes sociais, mas de 2022.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Um vídeo que mostra a plateia do Rock in Rio cantando um coro em apoio ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva durante um show do festival não é deste ano, como afirmam publicações nas redes sociais, mas de 2022. Aqui estão os principais detalhes: “Rock in Rio 2026: o público puxa ‘olê, olê, olê, olá... Lula, Lula!’”, diz a legenda de uma postagem no Instagram . O vídeo mostra a plateia cantando em apoio ao presidente, enquanto a banda que se apresenta no palco acompanha o ritmo com guitarra. O registro, porém, foi feito durante o show da banda Gilsons no Rock in Rio de 2022. A mesma filmagem foi compartilhada à época por um usuário no X, e a imprensa , como a Folha de S.Paulo e o UOL, publicou reportagens sobre a manifestação. A edição do Rock in Rio deste ano começou na sexta-feira passada, com shows nos dias 4, 5, 6 e 7 de setembro, e seguirá nos dias 11, 12 e 13. Os Gilsons ainda não se apresentaram na edição de 2026 . O show da banda no festival está marcado para o próximo sábado. A Reuters não localizou manifestações semelhantes pró-Lula no Rock in Rio deste ano. VEREDICTO: Enganoso. É de 2022, e não deste ano, um vídeo em que o público canta em apoio a Lula no Rock in Rio. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

item.title: Oil pushes past $100 as wave of US-Iran attacks exposes dwindling safety net
item.description: Oil prices topped $100 a barrel on Wednesday for the first time in six weeks as an escalation in fighting by U.S. and Iranian forces deepened concerns over supply from the region and raised fears of inflationary pressures and higher energy costs for consumers and businesses.
item.dc:creator: Tony Munroe, Alex Lawler
item.content:encoded: Oil prices topped $100 a barrel on Wednesday for the first time in six weeks as an escalation in fighting by U.S. and Iranian forces deepened concerns over supply from the region and raised fears of inflationary pressures and higher energy costs for consumers and businesses. Brent, a global oil benchmark, has risen by a quarter since early last month as hopes fade for a permanent resolution to the six-month-old U.S.-Iran conflict . The rally accelerated this week after Iran-backed Houthi attacks on [USN:L6N451042 TEXT:"Saudi energy facilities"] set oil installations ablaze, increasing the risk that disruptions could spread across the wider Gulf region. Oil's break above the $100 level signals growing concerns that the global market has become increasingly vulnerable after months of supply losses due to disruptions to oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz and inventory drawdowns. "Oil investors are expressing their view about the impact of the latest bout of escalation in the Middle East in an unambiguous way," said Tamas Varga, of oil broker PVM. "They are voting with their dollar, and this vote strongly indicates that unless the Strait of Hormuz re-opens, and oil starts flowing again uninterruptedly, supply will not be aligned with demand in the foreseeable future." While Brent futures have yet to reach the $126 mark struck earlier in the conflict, a sustained period above $100 a barrel could be felt beyond energy markets, raising transport and manufacturing costs, reigniting inflation fears and keeping interest rates higher for longer. OIL STOCKS ARE LOW Six months of reduced oil exports from the Middle East due to the war in Iran have helped deplete oil stocks in some key consumers. The United States has also drawn heavily on its [USN:L6N44S0QZ TEXT:"Strategic Petroleum Reserve"], leaving it at its lowest level since 1982. The reserve now holds 289.7 million barrels after years of releases by former President Joe Biden and President Donald Trump aimed at cushioning consumers from high fuel prices. High pump prices are a risk for Trump's Republican Party, which will be campaigning to retain narrow majorities in both houses of Congress during November's [USN:L1N44V0PF TEXT:"midterm elections"]. The national [USN:L6N44T16N TEXT:"average gasoline price"] was expected to hit $4.03 a gallon for the Labor Day weekend. Analysts say $4 per gallon is a pain point for many consumers. The West's energy watchdog, the International Energy Agency, in March announced a release of 400 million barrels from emergency oil reserves and says the global economy still has substantial stocks. About three quarters of this have been released. Total global oil stocks, including all types such as commercial stocks, the U.S. SPR, Chinese stocks and stocks on water, look fairly comfortable, according to the IEA. Still, a big chunk of those are either in transit, committed to buyers or held in countries that provide little public information about available reserves, such as China. OIL FLOWS FROM MIDDLE EAST STILL DISRUPTED Prices remain below the peak reached in April, when Brent surged as high as $126 a barrel. But the return to oil above the triple-digit level poses a risk to a market with little room for error, as reduced inventories and limited spare capacity leave supplies vulnerable to further disruptions. About 10 million barrels per day, or about 10% of world oil demand, of oil exports are still missing as a result of the Iran war, according to estimates from Vortexa, which tracks oil shipments. While some producers including the United States, Canada and Guyana have ramped up output, the IEA said last month it expected global oil supply would fall this year by 4.3 million bpd, or about 4%. With emergency stockpiles depleted and millions of barrels a day already offline, analysts say the market has less capacity to absorb new disruptions than it did at the start of the war. "I think the market is trying to treat this rise in energy prices as a one-off. It's not. This is structural. It's not going away, and it's part of what I would argue as a security premium. And it's only going to get bigger," said Jeffrey Currie, co-chairman at Abaxx Markets.

item.title: IAEA board draws a line under past Syrian nuclear activities
item.description: The U.N. nuclear watchdog's 35-nation Board of Governors passed a resolution on Wednesday drawing a line under Syria's secret nuclear activities during the Assad family's rule, saying the new authorities had helped resolve all outstanding questions.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The U.N. nuclear watchdog's 35-nation Board of Governors passed a resolution on Wednesday drawing a line under Syria's secret nuclear activities during the Assad family's rule, saying the new authorities had helped resolve all outstanding questions. After Israel bombed a site in the eastern province of Deir al-Zor in 2007 that it said was a secret nuclear reactor near completion, the International Atomic Energy Agency demanded Syria come clean on its nuclear activities, which it did not do. The IAEA board declared Syria in breach of its non-proliferation obligations in 2011 and reported it to the U.N. Security Council. After the overthrow of Syrian ruler Bashar al-Assad in 2024, Syria's new authorities pledged to work with the IAEA in helping clear up the past activities. In a [USN:L1N44T0TI TEXT:"confidential report"] to member states last week, seen by Reuters, the IAEA said it had resolved all its questions about the outstanding issues originally reported to the board, and the resolution passed on Wednesday said Syria was no longer in non-compliance with its obligations. "(The board) welcomes the transparency and cooperation of the Syrian Arab Republic, commends it for the actions taken in resolving its non-compliance," the resolution text submitted by Egypt, Jordan, Morocco and Saudi Arabia said. The resolution was passed by consensus, meaning no state objected, diplomats at the closed-door meeting said. The IAEA report confirmed it was "very likely" the bombed site was a nuclear reactor, and said fuel for it was made in Syria. The IAEA found around 73 metric tons of natural uranium metal in Syria, most of it in the form of fuel rods. That material is now under IAEA oversight, and Syria has said it will [USN:L1N44F0FC TEXT:"stay in the country"].

item.title: Facing Pirates, White Sox RHP Davis Martin pursues elusive win
item.description: Chicago White Sox right-hander Davis Martin said he felt he "was kind of getting in front of my skis a little bit" amid extended struggles.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Chicago White Sox right-hander Davis Martin said he felt he "was kind of getting in front of my skis a little bit" amid extended struggles. Martin knows the best version of himself is the one who harnesses his focus to halt hitters. That remains his aim Wednesday night as American League Central-leading Chicago continues a home series against the Pittsburgh Pirates. "Every day has its own little wins, and I need to make sure I'm checking the box," Martin said. "And if I do that during the week, day five is going to take care of itself." Actually, Wednesday will mark seven days since Martin (9-6, 4.13 ERA) took his most recent turn in the rotation. He stymied the Astros for 5 2/3 scoreless innings at Houston on Sept. 2 in his return from the injured list with a blister on his right middle finger. The White Sox lost 2-0. Chicago (75-69) adjusted the start to allow more time for Martin to rest and put him in line to pitch the opener of a key American League Central series in Cleveland next week. The Guardians pulled within two games of the division lead on Tuesday, earning a 9-5 win at Baltimore while the Pirates pounded the White Sox 9-3. It would be a good day for Martin to get his first win since June 10, when he stood 9-2 with a 2.41 ERA. Martin has never faced Pittsburgh, which entered the series opener with only three runs in its past three games but stormed to five first-inning runs. Seven Pirates had multiple hits in the game. Oneil Cruz and Rafael Flores both went 3-for-5 to pace an 18-hit effort that included six doubles. "I mean, just stay confident," Flores said. "We're in the big leagues for a reason; we're all really good hitters. We've just got to keep staying confident and just keep going." The Pirates (72-73) have won seven of their past nine games as they stay afloat in the race for the third NL wild card. They enter play Wednesday 5 1/2 games behind the Arizona Diamondbacks, who occupy the spot. Flores Jr. paced the Pirates with six total bases on Tuesday, including a solo home run in the fifth inning. Kyle Teel, his catching counterpart for Chicago, also hit a solo homer. Teel has gone deep in consecutive games and has three hits in 12 at-bats since rejoining the team this month after spraining his left ankle on July 21. "Just making small adjustments every day and putting work in with the hitting coaches," Teel said. "I feel like the big thing this week was just figuring out my routine. I feel like just because I've been playing, then not playing, I haven't really had a set routine that I do every day. "And I'm starting to lock that in, so that feels good." A victory would give the Pirates their fifth consecutive series win. While duplicating Tuesday's start can't happen every game, manager Don Kelly said good habits still carry over. "I thought we had a really good approach ... especially early on," Pittsburgh manager Don Kelly said. "I think that when we're rolling like that, and you see the confidence that breeds throughout the lineup, I thought it was really good." Pittsburgh will opt for a bullpen game against Martin. Right-hander Lake Bachar (1-3, 3.59 ERA) will serve as the opener for the Pirates in his third straight start. Bachar contributed 2 1/3 scoreless innings against San Francisco on Thursday while scattering two walks, one hit batter and three strikeouts. He delivered three innings of one-run relief against the White Sox while pitching for the Miami Marlins in his team's 9-4 loss on March 30. --Field Level Media

item.title: Fed to hold rates steady in rest of 2026; rising number of analysts see at least one hike: Reuters poll
item.description: The Federal Reserve will hold its interest rate steady at its September 15-16 meeting and for the rest of this year, again defying market expectations for a series of hikes, according to a majority of economists in a Reuters poll.
item.dc:creator: Indradip Ghosh
item.content:encoded: The Federal Reserve will hold its interest rate steady at its September 15-16 meeting and for the rest of this year, again defying market expectations for a series of hikes, according to a majority of economists in a Reuters poll. Economic data have mostly [USN:L1N44W0EC TEXT:"come in strong"] in recent weeks, and several economists said the Consumer Price Index data for August, due to be released on Friday, will be important for them to solidify their thinking on what comes next for rates. Economists' conviction around their forecasts more broadly has waned considerably since Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh adopted a policy of providing little or no guidance on what is coming next from the world's most powerful central bank. Given that there are generally more forecasters now expecting higher rates this year than in the previous poll, there is a risk that a consensus for no change in rates flips to a hike, based on conversations with several contributors. "If everything plays out as we're expecting, then they'll stay on hold next week. But if there's an upside surprise on the inflation data, they're not going to wait around. They're likely to start a hiking cycle," said Eli Nir, U.S. economist at TD Securities. About 70% of economists, 65 of 93, in the September 4-9 Reuters poll expect the federal funds rate to remain in the 3.50%-3.75% range next week. That reading is down from 90% in August. The rest expect a quarter-percentage-point increase, which would be the first since July 2023. About 56% of economists, 52 of 93, predict rates will remain on hold for the whole year, down from 80% in recent months. The rest expect at least one hike, more than double the share last month. Among primary dealers, the split is a bit closer on whether or not the Fed will raise rates this year. Half of those polled, 11, expect rates to remain on hold this year, while 10 expect at least one hike and one contributor, Jefferies, expects the U.S. central bank to cut rates. FED POLICYMAKERS DIVIDED TOO The policy-setting Federal Open Market Committee was sharply divided at its [USN:L6N43Q12Z TEXT:"July 28-29 meeting"], with three of its members opting for a rate increase. Warsh's speech at the Fed's [USN:L6N44P0MM TEXT:"Jackson Hole economic symposium"] in Wyoming last month was widely perceived as hawkish. Taken together with a surge in crude oil futures back above $100 a barrel amid renewed escalation in the [USN:L6N451042 TEXT:"war in the Middle East"], financial markets have now priced in two rate hikes by March. Yields on the interest-rate-sensitive two-year Treasury notes have surged around 20 basis points since Warsh's Jackson Hole speech, while the yield on the 10-year Treasury note is trading close to 5%. Trump administration officials have made it clear that 5% is a line they do not want crossed. "In my view, Chairman Warsh coming out firmly in the camp of the hawks at Jackson Hole means that a hike is probable this month unless Friday's CPI release brings a substantial downside surprise," said Stephen Stanley, chief U.S. economist at Santander. September has been an important month for the Fed in recent years. It launched its latest easing cycle in September 2024 and resumed cutting rates last September after a roughly eight-month pause. A separate Reuters poll on the upcoming CPI data predicted a 0.4% month-on-month rise after a 0.1% increase in July. Inflation on a year-over-year basis is expected to hold steady at 3.4%. Inflation as measured by the Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index remains [USN:L1N44N0KC TEXT:"well above"] the Fed's 2% target and has stayed there for more than five years. The persistence of above-target inflation is putting political pressure on President Donald Trump's fellow Republicans as they try to keep control of Congress in the midterm elections in November. Trump, who has one of the lowest approval ratings on record in presidential opinion polls, recently threatened wide-reaching trade restrictions unless the Fed cuts rates. Economists now forecast annual PCE inflation at 3.5% this year and 2.4% in 2027, unchanged from last month's estimates, with inflation unlikely to return to the Fed's 2% target before 2028. Unemployment is expected to remain near the 4.1% level. ([USN:L6N44V0OV TEXT:"Other stories"] from the Reuters global economic poll)

item.title: Netzagentur: Viele Gebote für neue Gaskraftwerke
item.description: Bei der Bundesnetzagentur sind in der ersten Runde der Ausschreibung des Bundes für neue Gaskraftwerke zahlreiche Gebote eingegangen. Die Ausschreibung sei deutlich überzeichnet gewesen, teilte die Bonner Behörde am Mittwoch mit. Eine genaue Zahl nannte sie nicht. Die Netzagentur beginne jetzt mit der Prüfung der Gebote. Dabei gehe es insbesondere darum, ob die Bieter alle Teilnahmevoraussetzungen erfüllen und keine Ausschlussgründe vorliegen. Ein Gebot wäre etwa auszuschließen, wenn es Bedingungen, Befristungen oder sonstige Nebenabreden enthielte. Die Zuschläge würden bis zum 3. November bekannt gegeben.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bei der Bundesnetzagentur sind in der ersten Runde der Ausschreibung des Bundes für neue Gaskraftwerke zahlreiche Gebote eingegangen. Die Ausschreibung sei deutlich überzeichnet gewesen, teilte die Bonner Behörde am Mittwoch mit. Eine genaue Zahl nannte sie nicht. Die Netzagentur beginne jetzt mit der Prüfung der Gebote. Dabei gehe es insbesondere darum, ob die Bieter alle Teilnahmevoraussetzungen erfüllen und keine Ausschlussgründe vorliegen. Ein Gebot wäre etwa auszuschließen, wenn es Bedingungen, Befristungen oder sonstige Nebenabreden enthielte. Die Zuschläge würden bis zum 3. November bekannt gegeben. Die modernen Gaskraftanlagen sollen zu jeder Zeit einspringen können, wenn die immer größer werdende Stromversorgung aus erneuerbaren Energien nicht ausreicht. Die neuen Kraftwerke sollen später auch mit Wasserstoff betrieben werden. Konzerne wie RWE (RWEG.DE) und Uniper (UN0k.DE) hatten angekündigt, sich an den Ausschreibungen zu beteiligen. Von den Unternehmen war zunächst keine Stellungnahme zu erhalten. NOCH DIVERSE WEITERE RUNDEN GEPLANT 2026 gebe es zwei Ausschreibungen für Erzeugungsanlagen, die über einen längeren Zeitraum Strom erzeugen können, erklärte die Netzagentur. In diesen beiden Ausschreibungen würden jeweils 4,5 Gigawatt reduzierte Leistung ausgeschrieben. Für den Fall, dass die ausgeschriebene reduzierte Leistung nicht in der vollen Höhe von neun Gigawatt vergeben werden könne, würde es einen dritten Gebotstermin am 18. Mai 2027 geben. Bis 2029 seien weitere Runden geplant.

item.title: DBS sued for US$1 billion in 1MDB-linked claim
item.description: DBS rejected the claim and said it would fight it vigorously, adding that the company has made no provision for the lawsuit.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

DBS sued for US$1 billion in 1MDB-linked claim

DBS rejected the claim and said it would fight it vigorously, adding that the company has made no provision for the lawsuit.

A DBS company signage is seen on the bank's headquarters at the central business district in Singapore on Mar 14, 2025. (File photo: AFP/Roslan Rahman)

SINGAPORE: Liquidators of four companies linked to recovery efforts in the multibillion-dollar 1MDB scandal have sued DBS Bank, seeking an estimated S$1.298 billion (US$1.03 billion) in damages, Southeast Asia's largest lender DBS said on Wednesday (Sep 9). The claimants include the liquidators of four companies: Blackrock Commodities (Global), Platinum Global Luxury Services, Affinity Equity International Partners and TKIL Global Investments. The liquidators did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment. Malaysian state fund 1MDB, or 1Malaysia Development Berhad, co-founded by then Prime Minister Najib Razak in 2009, was at the heart of a global corruption scandal in which US authorities said at least US$4.5 billion was misappropriated, sparking investigations and asset-recovery efforts worldwide. In a statement to the Singapore Exchange, DBS rejected the claim and said it would fight it vigorously, adding that the company has made no provision for the lawsuit. "It is a matter of public record that there have been global recovery efforts relating to 1Malaysia Development Berhad, supported by legal counsel since 2018. All this time, there was no claim against DBS," it said.

Related:

Singapore court grants winding up bids for three entities linked to 1MDB scandal, liquidators say

Goldman Sachs to pay US$500 million to settle shareholder lawsuit over 1MDB scandal

item.title: Baker Hughes raises annual forecasts after Chart purchase, signals LNG recovery ahead
item.description: U.S. oilfield services provider Baker Hughes raised its full-year forecasts on Wednesday, reflecting the benefits of its $13.6 billion acquisition of industrial equipment maker Chart Industries.
item.dc:creator: Vallari Srivastava, Pranav Mathur
item.content:encoded: U.S. oilfield services provider Baker Hughes (BKR.O) raised its full-year forecasts on Wednesday, reflecting the benefits of its $13.6 billion acquisition of industrial equipment maker Chart Industries. Speaking at the Barclays Annual Energy conference, CEO Lorenzo Simonelli also struck an optimistic tone on liquefied natural gas (LNG) markets, where equipment demand has [USN:L4N3YG0V6 TEXT:"been pressured"] by the slow pace of new project sanctions and customer spending. "We see improving visibility toward an LNG order recovery as we move into 2027," Simonelli said. Shares of the company were up 3.2% in early trading. Baker Hughes completed the acquisition of Chart in July [USN:L8N43C11E TEXT:"after securing"] EU antitrust approval on the condition it would sell the industrial gear manufacturer's proprietary process technology and its small-scale process technology business, while ensuring the interoperability of its gear with third parties' LNG equipment. Baker Hughes now expects revenue of $28.50 billion to $30.30 billion in 2026, up from its prior forecast of $26.65 billion to $28.05 billion. Annual adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) is expected at $4.88 billion to $5.48 billion, compared with its earlier forecast of $4.6 billion to $5.1 billion. Simonelli said the company expects 55% to 65% of Chart's segment core profit to be realized in the fourth quarter, reflecting both the mid-July close of the transaction and Chart's typical seasonal weighting toward the final quarter of the year. Near-term Chart margins are being impacted by the timing of LNG equipment volumes and soft hydrogen demand, he added. Analysts expect the company to report revenue of $28.31 billion and core profit of $5.09 billion in 2026, according to data compiled by LSEG.

item.title: Pistorius: Deutschland im Fadenkreuz Moskaus – Etat ist "Sicherheitsversprechen"
item.description: Bundesverteidigungsminister Boris Pistorius hat den geplanten Rekord-Wehretat für das Jahr 2027 mit einer direkten Bedrohung durch Russland begründet. "Russland versucht, unsere Gesellschaften auszuspähen, zu beeinflussen, einzuschüchtern, zu destabilisieren und vor allem die Menschen zu verunsichern", sagte der SPD-Politiker am Mittwoch in der Haushaltsdebatte des Bundestages. "Wir sind buchstäblich im Fadenkreuz Moskaus." Der Verteidigungshaushalt sei deshalb nicht nur ein großer Etat, sondern ein "Sicherheitsversprechen". Denn ohne Sicherheit sei alles andere nichts.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bundesverteidigungsminister Boris Pistorius hat den geplanten Rekord-Wehretat für das Jahr 2027 mit einer direkten Bedrohung durch Russland begründet. "Russland versucht, unsere Gesellschaften auszuspähen, zu beeinflussen, einzuschüchtern, zu destabilisieren und vor allem die Menschen zu verunsichern", sagte der SPD-Politiker am Mittwoch in der Haushaltsdebatte des Bundestages. "Wir sind buchstäblich im Fadenkreuz Moskaus." Der Verteidigungshaushalt sei deshalb nicht nur ein großer Etat, sondern ein "Sicherheitsversprechen". Denn ohne Sicherheit sei alles andere nichts. Der Verteidigungsetat soll den Plänen zufolge im Jahr 2027 zusammen mit Mitteln aus dem Sondervermögen auf rund 140 Milliarden Euro anwachsen. Der reguläre Wehretat (Einzelplan 14) sieht dabei Ausgaben von 109,7 Milliarden Euro vor, weitere 29,9 Milliarden Euro sollen aus dem Sondervermögen Bundeswehr finanziert werden. Damit würden die Verteidigungsausgaben gegenüber dem laufenden Jahr um rund 31,4 Milliarden Euro steigen. Der größte Teil der Mittel soll mit mehr als 60 Milliarden Euro in die militärische Beschaffung fließen. Der Haushaltsexperte der Grünen, Sebastian Schäfer, bemängelte allerdings eine planlose Kaufstrategie. Das Ministerium gehe mit dem Geld nach dem Motto vor: "Alles muss raus." So könne es nicht weitergehen. Parlamentarische Kontrolle sei bei den Vorlagen des Ministeriums kaum noch möglich.

item.title: Sapatos cobertos de cinzas e um presidente em crise: repórter da Reuters relembra o 11 de Setembro
item.description: O presidente George W. Bush estava em um campo de golfe na Flórida antes do amanhecer quando o vi pela primeira vez, em 11 de setembro de 2001.
item.dc:creator: Steve Holland
item.content:encoded: O presidente George W. Bush estava em um campo de golfe na Flórida antes do amanhecer quando o vi pela primeira vez, em 11 de setembro de 2001. Como um dos dois correspondentes da Reuters que acompanhavam Bush naquele dia, eu estava cobrindo o que se esperava ser um evento rotineiro com crianças em idade escolar para promover suas políticas educacionais. Ele era presidente dos Estados Unidos há menos de oito meses. Em poucas horas, o inexperiente Bush se viu diante do pior ataque em solo norte-americano desde Pearl Harbor, em 1941. A tragédia se desenrolou enquanto Bush visitava a Escola Primária Emma E. Booker, em Sarasota, na Flórida. Enquanto o presidente se reunia com funcionários e alunos, eu estava em um centro de imprensa próximo, montado para os repórteres. Assistimos a uma transmissão ao vivo pela televisão mostrando fumaça saindo de uma das torres gêmeas do World Trade Center, em Nova York. Ela havia sido atingida por um avião, no que inicialmente presumimos ser um acidente. Então, enquanto assistíamos, um segundo avião colidiu. Bush estava na escola, lendo para as crianças. As câmeras captaram a expressão de choque em seu rosto quando um assessor da Casa Branca entrou na sala de aula e sussurrou para ele sobre o segundo avião, dizendo: “Os Estados Unidos estão sob ataque”. No final da semana, Bush demonstraria uma gama de emoções ao lidar com os eventos que marcaram um ponto de inflexão em sua Presidência e na vida norte-americana — horror e raiva diante dos ataques, pesar e lágrimas pelas vítimas, e promessas desafiadoras de fazer com que os responsáveis pagassem por isso. O ex-presidente, hoje com 80 anos, planeja participar de uma cerimônia na sexta-feira para marcar o 25º aniversário dos ataques no Ground Zero, em Nova York. Na noite de quarta-feira, ele compartilhará suas reflexões sobre o aniversário em sua biblioteca presidencial em Dallas, enquanto 16 obras de arte que ele pintou, refletindo a coragem e o sacrifício daquele dia, estarão em exibição. “Ficou evidente... que o mundo havia mudado”, diria Bush mais tarde ao programa “60 Minutes II”, da CBS. Bush passou o restante de sua Presidência trabalhando para impedir outro ataque semelhante. Os sequestros expuseram vulnerabilidades de segurança, levando ao reforço das medidas de segurança em aeroportos e prédios públicos. Seu governo foi alvo de críticas pelas táticas severas de interrogatório utilizadas contra alguns suspeitos de militância islâmica, e sua invasão do Iraque em 2003 foi vista por muitos como um erro que custou caro. O ex-presidente recusou um pedido de entrevista da Reuters para esta reportagem. CORRIDA PARA PROTEGER O PRESIDENTE Um quarto de século depois, as lembranças permanecem vívidas. Logo após os ataques com aviões sequestrados, houve uma corrida para proteger o presidente. Enquanto Bush era levado às pressas para o Air Force One para deixar a Flórida, a dimensão da crise ficava cada vez mais clara. As torres do World Trade Center desabaram, causando a morte de cerca de 3.000 pessoas. Um terceiro avião se chocou contra o Pentágono, matando 64 pessoas a bordo e 125 no prédio. Um quarto avião caiu em um campo em Shanksville, na Pensilvânia, depois que os passageiros resistiram aos sequestradores, e todas as 44 pessoas a bordo morreram. O pânico tomou conta de Washington. As nuvens de fumaça vindas do Pentágono geraram temores de carros-bomba. A Casa Branca foi esvaziada, com o Serviço Secreto orientando as funcionárias a tirarem os sapatos de salto alto e correrem. Bush passou o dia voando pelo país no Air Force One, primeiro para a Base Aérea de Barksdale, na Louisiana, e depois para a Base Aérea de Offutt, no Nebraska. Mais tarde, ele pressionaria por melhores equipamentos de comunicação no Air Force One, depois de ter tido dificuldade em manter contato com a Casa Branca enquanto sobrevoava o país. Em Nebraska, ele entrou em um bunker subterrâneo para realizar uma teleconferência com os principais assessores de segurança nacional e o vice-presidente Dick Cheney. Ansioso para voltar a Washington, Bush chegou à Casa Branca no final daquela tarde. Naquela noite, ele fez um discurso no Salão Oval. “As imagens de aviões colidindo com edifícios, incêndios, estruturas gigantescas desabando nos encheram de descrença, de uma tristeza terrível e de uma raiva silenciosa e implacável”, disse Bush. Enquanto isso, junto com grande parte da imprensa da Casa Branca, eu ainda estava retido na Flórida, sem poder voar para lugar algum, já que todo o tráfego aéreo havia sido suspenso. Como presidente da Associação de Correspondentes da Casa Branca na época, ajudei a pressionar por nosso retorno para casa e, finalmente, pegamos um ônibus fretado de volta à capital. Após uma viagem de 14 horas, nossa primeira visão de Washington foi o buraco fumegante no Pentágono. Em 14 de setembro, viajei com Bush até o Ground Zero. As torres ainda estavam em chamas, e o cheiro era perceptível a quilômetros de distância. Enquanto Bush caminhava pelo local devastado com o então prefeito Rudy Giuliani, havia a preocupação de que alguns prédios vizinhos tivessem ficado tão fragilizados a ponto de desabar. Uma espessa camada de cinzas cobria tudo: calçadas, ruas e os ombros dos bombeiros exaustos. Em pé sobre os escombros de um caminhão de bombeiros, Bush disse às equipes de emergência que os Estados Unidos estavam agora em guerra contra militantes islâmicos. “Eu posso ouvir vocês! Eu posso ouvir vocês! O resto do mundo ouve vocês! E as pessoas que derrubaram esses prédios vão ouvir todos nós em breve!”, disse ele por meio de um megafone. Os sapatos que eu usava naquele dia estavam cobertos de cinzas e fuligem. Quando cheguei em casa, coloquei-os em um saco plástico e guardei-os no armário. Vinte e cinco anos depois, lá estão eles. Muito estragados para usar, muito queridos para jogar fora.

item.title: India lifts ban on JPMorgan unit, broker in market-manipulation case, sources say
item.description: India's markets regulator has lifted a trading ban on a JPMorgan Chase & Co unit and Mansi Share and Stock Broking over alleged manipulation of the closing auction session after the firms deposited a combined 36.8 million rupees ($386,941), two sources familiar with the matter told Reuters on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Jayshree Pyasi
item.content:encoded: India's markets regulator has lifted a trading ban on a JPMorgan Chase & Co (JPM.N) unit and Mansi Share and Stock Broking over alleged manipulation of the closing auction session after the firms deposited a combined 36.8 million rupees ($386,941), two sources familiar with the matter told Reuters on Wednesday. The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) last month [USN:L4N44G195 TEXT:"banned"] the two firms from the market, alleging they manipulated trades in a newly launched closing-auction mechanism used to determine the final official price of securities at the end of a trading day. Copthall Mauritius Investment Ltd, a JPMorgan entity, remains barred from participating in the closing auction session pending the outcome of the investigation, the sources said, speaking on condition of anonymity because the matter is confidential. SEBI, JPMorgan and Mansi Share and Stock Broking did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Launched on August 3, the closing auction is a roughly 20-minute auction during which buy and sell orders are matched to determine a stock's official closing price. While similar systems exist in other markets, the mechanism's first month in India saw sharp swings in derivatives prices, divergences between prices on the country's two exchanges and signs that it was prone to manipulation, prompting the regulator to start a review last week. Last month, the regulator alleged that aggressive buy orders placed by Copthall and large sell orders by Mansi during the auction distorted the prices of stocks in the Sensex index. ($1 = 95.1050 Indian rupees)

item.title: Saab wins $303 million order from Sweden for work on future combat aircraft
item.description: Swedish defence group Saab said on Wednesday it had received an order worth around 2.9 billion crowns ($302.99 million) from Sweden for continued work on future military aircraft.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Swedish defence group Saab (SAABb.ST) said on Wednesday it had received an order worth around 2.9 billion crowns ($302.99 million) from Sweden for continued work on future military aircraft. Saab, maker of the Gripen fighter jet, said in a statement that it will develop new technologies for future manned and unmanned combat aircraft. The contract period is 2026-2028, with options to extend through 2030. Prompted by Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022, Sweden is racing to build up its military strength, and has become NATO's newest member. Saab in August showcased a full-scale concept model of a future potential unmanned combat air system. ($1 = 9.5713 Swedish crowns)

item.title: Sovecon recorta previsión de exportación de granos de Rusia para 2026/27 por perturbaciones en mar Negro
item.description: La consultora especializada en cereales SovEcon rebajó sus previsiones sobre las exportaciones de cereales de Rusia para la campaña 2026/27, a medida que se agravan las perturbaciones en el corredor de exportación que une el mar de Azov con el mar Negro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La consultora especializada en cereales SovEcon rebajó sus previsiones sobre las exportaciones de cereales de Rusia para la campaña 2026/27, a medida que se agravan las perturbaciones en el corredor de exportación que une el mar de Azov con el mar Negro. Rusia y Ucrania, ambos grandes exportadores de granos, han intensificado los ataques contra los buques de carga del bando contrario en una escalada de la guerra que ya dura cuatro años y medio. SovEcon rebajó su previsión de exportación de trigo ruso en 3,2 millones de toneladas, a 41,4 millones de toneladas. Ahora prevé que las exportaciones totales de cereales de Rusia alcancen los 49,4 millones de toneladas, frente a los 53,8 millones de toneladas estimados el mes anterior.

item.title: Filho de Raikkonen entra para o programa de formação de pilotos da Red Bull
item.description: Robin Raikkonen, filho de 11 anos do campeão mundial de 2007 Kimi Raikkonen, tornou-se o mais recente talento a ingressar no programa de desenvolvimento de pilotos da Red Bull, anunciou a equipe de Fórmula 1 nesta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Robin Raikkonen, filho de 11 anos do campeão mundial de 2007 Kimi Raikkonen, tornou-se o mais recente talento a ingressar no programa de desenvolvimento de pilotos da Red Bull, anunciou a equipe de Fórmula 1 nesta quarta-feira. Apelidado de “Ace”, Robin tem se mostrado promissor em campeonatos de kart e começará a trabalhar com a equipe a partir de 2027, em um programa que já revelou pilotos de F1 como Sebastian Vettel e Max Verstappen — ambos tetracampeões. “Estamos todos entusiasmados e animados com o fato de Robin ter sido escolhido para seguir sua trajetória no automobilismo como membro do Red Bull Junior Team”, disse Kimi em um comunicado. “Eles oferecem um programa atraente e abrangente para desenvolver e estimular o progresso de Robin nos próximos anos, além de proporcionar a ele toda a experiência necessária para desenvolver seu talento natural, que já foi amplamente demonstrado em todas as suas participações no kart até o momento.” Raikkonen disputou mais de 350 Grandes Prêmios de Fórmula 1, conquistando 21 vitórias e 103 pódios. Ele também participou do Campeonato Mundial de Rali e experimentou a Nascar. O finlandês, apelidado de “Homem de gelo”, foi o último piloto da Ferrari a vencer o campeonato de F1, conquistando seu único título em 2007. O chefe da equipe Red Bull, Laurent Mekies, disse que Robin “já demonstrou habilidade excepcional no kart”, ao mesmo tempo em que elogiou sua velocidade e habilidade nas pistas. “Nosso objetivo é desenvolvê-lo passo a passo, sem colocar nenhuma pressão desnecessária sobre seus ombros”, disse Mekies. “O caminho no automobilismo é longo, e vamos dar a ele o tempo, o apoio e os recursos de que precisa para maximizar seu potencial.” Robin segue os passos de Ella Hakkinen, filha do bicampeão mundial finlandês Mika Hakkinen, que ingressou no programa de desenvolvimento de pilotos da McLaren no ano passado. (Reportagem de Rohith Nair em Bengaluru)

item.title: Singapore's DBS faces $1 billion lawsuit in alleged 1MDB-linked claim
item.description: DBS Bank is being sued for an estimated S$1.298 billion ($1.03 billion) in damages linked to the multibillion-dollar 1MDB scandal, Southeast Asia's largest lender DBS Group said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: DBS Bank is being sued for an estimated S$1.298 billion ($1.03 billion) in damages linked to the multibillion-dollar 1MDB scandal, Southeast Asia's largest lender DBS Group (DBSM.SI) said on Wednesday. The claimants include the liquidators of four companies: BlackRock Commodities (Global), Platinum Global Luxury Services, Affinity Equity International Partners and TKIL Global Investments. The liquidators did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment. DBS rejected the claim and said it would fight it vigorously, adding that the company has made no provision for the lawsuit. The bank did not provide any more details on the allegations it faces. The lawsuit is the latest among wide-ranging efforts to recover money belonging to [USN:L4N2ZV1GE TEXT:"1Malaysia Development Berhad"] (1MDB), from which U.S. investigators say about $4.5 billion was stolen between 2009 and 2014 in a complex, globe-spanning scheme. All this time, there was no claim against DBS, according to the lender's statement. In [USN:L4N3SY0BO TEXT:"July last year"], liquidators trying to recover money from 1MDB sued Standard Chartered Bank in Singapore, alleging it enabled fraud that led to more than $2.7 billion in financial losses between 2009 and 2013. Shares of DBS closed 0.8% lower at S$77.50 earlier in the day. ($1 = 1.2635 Singapore dollars) (This story has been corrected to say there had been no claim against DBS 'all this time,' not 'at the time,' in paragraph 5.)

item.title: Ibovespa cai com cenário externo sem tirar Brasília do radar
item.description: O Ibovespa recuava nesta quarta-feira, com o cenário externo endossando ajustes no pregão paulista, enquanto investidores seguem acompanhando a crise no Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) e seus potenciais reflexos no cenário eleitoral.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: O Ibovespa recuava nesta quarta-feira, com o cenário externo endossando ajustes no pregão paulista, enquanto investidores seguem acompanhando a crise no Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) e seus potenciais reflexos no cenário eleitoral. Por volta de 11h05, o índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro (.BVSP) cedia 0,6%, a 186.249,93 pontos, com as ações da Petrobras e da Vale atuando como um amortecedor na pressão negativa. O volume financeiro no pregão somava R$5,94 bilhões. O barril do [USN:L1N451087 TEXT:"petróleo"] sob o contrato Brent avançava 2,93%, a US$100,79, após uma escalada dos ataques no Oriente Médio, incluindo contra petroleiros, frustrar esperanças de uma normalização do transporte da commodity na região. Em Nova York, o S&P 500 (.SPX) , uma das referências do mercado acionário norte-americano, perdia 0,25%. De acordo com o responsável pela área de renda variável da Criteria, Thiago Pedroso, o movimento do Brent reforça a preocupação com a inflação justamente após a [USN:L1N44W0K6 TEXT:"criação de empregos"] nos EUA em agosto reacender as apostas de alta dos juros no país. No Brasil, o ministro Flávio Dino, do STF, determinou nesta quarta-feira a [USN:L1N4510HB TEXT:"reintegração"] de Andrei Rodrigues ao cargo de diretor-geral da Polícia Federal um dia após o colega da corte, André Mendonça, ter ordenado o afastamento dele do cargo. Os reflexos políticos da crise no STF sobre o governo do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) "têm dado ainda mais impulso à campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL)", afirmou comentário da área de Sales and Trading do UBS a clientes nesta quarta-feira. Na véspera, em meio ao agravamento da tensão na corte e novas pesquisas mostrando um cenário acirrado na disputa presidencial, o Ibovespa chegou a 189.487,70 pontos, renovando máxima intradia desde o final de abril. Estrangeiros têm ajudado a sustentar o tom positivo no pregão brasileiro recentemente, com uma entrada líquida de R$5,3 bilhões em setembro até o dia 4. DESTAQUES ITAÚ UNIBANCO PN recuava 1,65%, em pregão de ajustes após sete altas seguidas, com o setor como um todo no Ibovespa com sinal negativo (.IFNC) . BRADESCO PN caía 1,59%, BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) perdia 1,33%, SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT cedia 2,6% e BTG PACTUAL UNIT era negociado com declínio de 2,2%. Investidores também estão atentos a possíveis medidas do Banco Central para lidar com o endividamento da população. PETROBRAS PN subia 1,31% e PETROBRAS ON (PETR3.SA) avançava 1,37%, apoiadas mais uma vez pelo movimento dos preços do petróleo no mercado internacional. O governo brasileiro publicou nesta quarta-feira no Diário Oficial da União medida provisória que destina R$6,6 bilhões para [USN:L6N4510YM TEXT:"subvenções"] de produção e importação de combustíveis. VALE ON (VALE3.SA) registrava elevação de 1,1%, mesmo com a fraqueza dos futuros do [USN:L6N4510UG TEXT:"minério de ferro"] na China, onde o contrato mais negociado na Bolsa de Commodities de Dalian fechou o pregão diurno com queda de 0,27%. No setor de mineração e siderurgia, CSN ON (CSNA3.SA) avançava 1,36%, tendo ainda de pano de fundo relatório de analistas do BTG Pactual iniciando uma recomendação tática de compra para os papéis. TENDA ON (TEND3.SA) caía 4,1%, em pregão negativo para construtoras na bolsa paulista, com MRV&CO ON (MRVE3.SA) também na ponta negativa, com recuo de 2,93%. O índice do setor imobiliário (.IMOB) mostrava queda de 1,87%, tendo no radar a alta das taxas dos contratos de DI. A Tenda também informou na véspera que Marcos Cruz [USN:L1N45010C TEXT:"assumiu"] a posição de presidente-executivo da companhia, em sucessão a Rodrigo Osmo. YDUQS ON (YDUQ3.SA) avançava 2,61%. Relatório de analistas do JPMorgan reiterou recomendação "overweight" para os papéis, bem como o preço-alvo de R$17 e a preferência pelas ações em relação aos papéis da Cogna, citando uma perspectiva melhor para o segundo semestre. COGNA ON (COGN3.SA) , que também tem recomendação "overweight" do JPMorgan, recuava 2,45%.

item.title: Champagne makers to draw on reserves after heatwaves shrink harvest
item.description: Champagne producers will draw on reserve wines after spring frosts and summer heatwaves cut this year's grape harvest, even as growers said the quality of the wine could be among the best in years.
item.dc:creator: Sybille de La Hamaide
item.content:encoded: Champagne producers will draw on reserve wines after spring frosts and summer heatwaves cut this year's grape harvest, even as growers said the quality of the wine could be among the best in years. The extreme weather that swept across France, the world's second-largest wine producer, pushed grape picking to some of the [USN:L6N44E0IY TEXT:"earliest dates on record"] in some regions, including Champagne, home to brands such as Moet & Chandon and Bollinger. The harvest advanced so quickly that some growers cut short their summer holidays and pickers were called back ahead of schedule, said Maxime Toubart, co-president of Comite Champagne (CIVC), the industry's governing body. "We were not quite ready," Toubart told reporters. 'EXCEPTIONAL' QUALITY The industry has trimmed production targets for several years as global [USN:L4N3U50JU TEXT:"alcohol consumption declines"] and economic uncertainty weighs on demand. Producers have also been watching the potential impact of U.S. [USN:L6N40514B TEXT:"tariff policies"]. France's agriculture ministry said on Monday that wine production in the Champagne region was expected [USN:L1N44Z07D TEXT:"to fall by about half"] from the previous year. That estimate can differ significantly from producer calculations because Champagne houses can draw on reserve wines held back from stronger harvests to help smooth out weaker ones. Most Champagne is made by blending wines from several harvests, giving producers greater flexibility to cope with poor vintages. While producers are expected to use reserves this year to compensate for the shortfall, some may choose to preserve part of those stocks for future blends. "Some producers may prefer to keep reserve wine for future blends, or bottle a little less," Toubart said. Despite the smaller harvest, producers described this year's wine quality as "exceptional", helped by ripe grapes and the absence of mildew. However, the high alcohol levels resulting from the hot weather are expected to pose challenges in winemaking. "The fact that the quality is there makes the lackluster yield a bit easier to swallow," Sebastien Debuisson, technical director of CIVC, said.

Sept 9 : Analog Devices will acquire privately held Alif Semiconductor for $1.35 billion in cash, the companies said on Wednesday, expanding ADI's on-device capabilities as AI applications increasingly move into physical systems. The acquisition would combine ADI's sensing, signal-processing and power-management technologies with Alif's AI processors, allowing customers to build systems that can analyze and respond in real time. Here are some more details: • Pleasanton, California-based Alif develops low-power processors that combine AI computing, data from sensors, connectivity and security functions for consumer and industrial applications.
